phase: Phase 17: Over-The-Air BLE Mesh GPX/GeoJSON Trail Sharing & Storage Manager

stories.title: Pure KMP Chunked Mesh File Transfer & GPX/GeoJSON Protocol Engine
stories.description: Implement pure KMP chunked file transmission engine (MeshFileTransferEngine.kt and MeshFileModels.kt) in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/map/. Splits large GPX/GeoJSON payloads into single-MTU chunks (<=120 bytes) with transfer IDs, chunk index/count, Adler32 checksum, sliding-window ACK/NACK retransmission, in-memory reassembly, and pure KMP GPX/GeoJSON parsers and exporters with zero Java/C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or external serialization dependencies (Rules 2 & 3)
Splits arbitrary GPX/GeoJSON trail data into MTU-compliant 120-byte chunks with Adler32 integrity checks
Sliding-window transmission with selective NACK retransmission over simulated lossy RF
Reassembles received chunks into typed TrailPolyline and TrailWaypoint models upon completion
100% unit test pass on JVM and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Subsystem Hardware Bridge Wiring & Reactive State Management
stories.description: Wire MeshFileTransferManager into Koin DI (AppModule.kt), IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, and IntercomBridge (iosMain) with typed CancellationHandle observers. Integrate into HomeUiState.kt and HomeViewModel.kt, managing active transfer progress, stored trail library, and actions to beam trail to convoy or import local GPX text.
acceptanceCriteria: Provides swift-friendly observeFileTransfers and observeStoredTrails callbacks with CancellationHandle (Rule 1)
HomeViewModel coordinates BeamActiveTrail, CancelTransfer, and LoadStoredTrail actions
Full test pass in sharedUI and sharedLogic modules

stories.title: Compose Multiplatform Trail File Manager & Over-The-Air Beam Cockpit Sheet
stories.description: Build TrailFileManagerSheet.kt in app/sharedUI displaying stored trail library, active trail switch, live OTA progress bars for sending/receiving chunks, and 1-tap 'Beam to Convoy' actuator. Wire into OfflineTrailCockpitSheet.kt and HomeScreen.kt adhering to zero-scroll handlebar layout contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders trail library with difficulty badges, total distance, elevation ascent, and active selection check
Renders dynamic transfer progress bars with percentage, chunk counter, and throughput
1-tap 'Beam to Convoy' broadcasts trail over mesh to all connected riders
Preserves single-viewport zero-scroll mobile handlebar layout constraint

stories.title: Native iOS SwiftUI Trail File Manager & Over-The-Air Beam Sheet
stories.description: Implement 100% native SwiftUI TrailFileManagerSheet.swift in app/iosApp (Rule 1). Wire IntercomViewModel observers with CancellationHandle, supporting trail library management, live OTA chunk transfer progress gauges, and 1-tap beam to mesh convoy.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% native SwiftUI with zero Compose Multiplatform imports (Rule 1)
Live transfer progress rings/bars showing outgoing and incoming trail chunks
Seamless integration with IntercomViewModel and CancellationHandle lifecycle
Full compilation and automated verification pass across all targets
